title: Multiple Custom Keywords - Building a Toolkit
description: Create multiple custom keywords and reuse them across tests.

story.setup: MENTOR-9: "One keyword is useful, but a TOOLKIT of keywords is powerful. Let's create multiple diagnostic procedures and use them in different tests."
story.context: You can define as many keywords as you need. Each test can call any keyword, and keywords can even call other keywords.
story.success: MENTOR-9: "Excellent! You've built a diagnostic toolkit. See how clean and readable your tests are now?"

instructions: Create test 'Startup Diagnostics' that calls two keywords: Initialize Systems, then Check Status
Create test 'Shutdown Diagnostics' that calls two keywords: Save State, then Power Down Systems
Create keyword 'Initialize Systems' that logs: 'Initializing all systems'
Create keyword 'Check Status' that logs: 'All systems operational'
Create keyword 'Save State' that logs: 'Saving system state'
Create keyword 'Power Down Systems' that logs: 'Powering down safely'
Note: Each test reuses different combinations of keywords
hints: You can have unlimited custom keywords in one file
Each keyword name on its own line at left margin
Tests can call keywords in any order
Keywords can be reused across multiple tests

theory.title: Exercise 2.2.2: Multiple Custom Keywords
theory.content:
🛠️ Building a Complete Toolkit

MENTOR-9: "PROTO-7, one screwdriver is useful, but a full toolbox is invaluable. Let's build multiple keywords - each a specialized tool."

"Tests can mix and match these keywords however they need. Startup uses Initialize + Check. Shutdown uses Save + Power Down."

🔄 Keyword Reusability

Multiple Keywords - Build a library of procedures in one file

  • ✅ Mix and match - Different tests use different keywords
  • ✅ No duplication - Each keyword defined once
  • ✅ Composability - Build complex flows from simple keywords
  • ✅ Clarity - Tests read like a checklist

Real-World Example:

Login Test:
    - Open Browser
    - Navigate To Login Page
    - Enter Credentials
    - Click Login Button
    - Verify Dashboard

Logout Test:
    - Open Browser  (reused!)
    - Navigate To Dashboard
    - Click Logout
    - Verify Login Page

📝 Multiple Keywords Example

*** Test Cases ***
Test One
    Keyword A
    Keyword B

Test Two
    Keyword B
    Keyword C

*** Keywords ***
Keyword A
    Log    Step in A

Keyword B
    Log    Step in B

Keyword C
    Log    Step in C

Notice:

  • 🔹 Keyword B is reused in both tests
  • 🔹 Each keyword is independent
  • 🔹 Tests compose keywords differently

📋 Multiple Keywords Best Practices

  • 🔹 Single Responsibility: Each keyword does ONE thing well
  • 🔹 Descriptive Names: Clear what the keyword does
  • 🔹 Logical Grouping: Related keywords near each other
  • 🔹 No Limit: Define as many keywords as needed
  • 🔹 Alphabetical Order: Optional but helps find keywords

🎯 Your Task

Create four custom keywords and two tests that use different combinations. See how keywords become reusable building blocks!
